name: Smuggler

feature.name: Down Low
desc: You are adept at finding hidden passages and secret routes through the wild or urban areas that others would miss. When you are in a settlement, you can find a safe place for you and your companions to stay and hide for as long as you need, provided you can pay for it or provide a service in return.

traits: I’m always looking for the nearest exit.
I have a contact in every port.
I never tell the whole truth if a half-truth will do.
I'm incredibly observant of my surroundings.
I love the thrill of a narrow escape.
I'm a bit cynical about the law and those who enforce it.
I can't resist a good bargain.
I'm always ready to move at a moment’s notice.
ideals: Freedom. No one should be able to tell me where I can or can't go. (Chaotic)
Profit. The only thing that matters is the bottom line. (Neutral)
Community. We have to look out for our own. (Lawful)
Charity. I smuggle what people need, not what the law says they can have. (Good)
Greed. I’ll move anything for the right price. (Evil)
Discovery. I want to see every corner of the world. (Any)
bonds: I owe a debt to a powerful crime lord.
My ship is my home and my crew is my family.
I’m trying to go straight for the sake of someone I love.
I have a secret stash of goods that I need to recover.
I was betrayed by my former partner, and I want revenge.
I’m searching for the legendary 'Smuggler’s Run'.
flaws: I have a price, and I can be bought.
I’m prone to taking unnecessary risks for extra profit.
I don't trust anyone who works for the government.
I have a reputation that precedes me in all the wrong ways.
I’m a bit too fond of the goods I’m supposed to be moving.
I turn tail and run at the first sign of trouble.

desc: You have spent your life moving goods illegally, avoiding patrols and taxes to turn a profit. Whether you were running medicine to the needy or weapons to rebels, you know how to stay 'down low' and get things where they need to go.
